# Artizanni Business Services Limited

> Artizanni is an Abuja-based design-build firm (RC 1065469, since 2012): architecture, civil, structural and MEP engineering, construction, interiors, real estate, project and property management, and an escrow-backed property service for Nigerians abroad.

- Registered: CAC RC 1065469, incorporated 17 September 2012
- Head office: No. 30 Anthony Enahoro Crescent, Utako District, Abuja, FCT, Nigeria
- Managing Director: Engr. Akolade Maruf Ibrahim, MNSE, PMP · COREN Reg. No. R29685
- Escrow partner for diaspora clients: First Trustees
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +234 701 802 4292, aec@artizanni.com, artizanni@gmail.com

## Services

### Design & Build
One contract, one team, one point of responsibility from brief to handover. With design and build, the people who design your project are the people who price it and build it. You deal with one company and one contract, and design gaps cannot become someone else's problem.
- Brief, site appraisal and feasibility
- Architectural, structural and services design, coordinated in-house
- Bills of quantities, material and labour schedules, construction programme
- Construction of substructure, frame, envelope, services and finishes
- Testing, snagging, as-built records and handover
- Defects-period support and optional facility management

### Architecture
Briefs, concepts, construction drawings and development-permit packs. Good architecture in Nigeria has to work with real plots, real budgets, approval offices and the climate. We design homes, estates, commercial and institutional buildings that can be approved, priced and built without surprises.
- Client brief and space programme
- Concept and schematic design with options
- Rendered 3D models and walk-through animation
- Planning and development-permit drawing packs
- Construction drawings, schedules and specifications
- Design for phased or incremental building
- Value engineering during design, so the drawings match the budget

### Civil, Structural & MEP Engineering
Structural design, civil works, drainage, foundations and building services. Engineering is our founding discipline. The practice is led by a COREN-registered civil and structural engineer, and our designs come from people who also stand on site when the concrete is poured.
- Structural design of reinforced concrete and steel buildings
- Foundations, retaining structures and heavy equipment plinths
- Roads, drainage, erosion control and site infrastructure
- Geotechnical / soil investigation coordination
- Mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) design and coordination, including solar and back-up power
- Structural integrity assessments of existing buildings
- Independent technical review of designs prepared by others

### Construction & Civil Works
Buildings, substations, dams, drainage, reclamation and roads, self-delivered. We build what we design, and we build for other designers too. Our site teams have delivered reinforced-concrete frames, power-infrastructure civils, dam rehabilitation, cofferdams, channelisation and land reclamation.
- Residential, commercial and industrial buildings
- Power infrastructure civils: substation earthworks, foundations, access roads, fencing
- Water works: cofferdams, dam and reservoir rehabilitation, dewatering
- Drainage, gabion revetment, erosion control and land reclamation
- Roads, hardstanding, kerbs and external works
- Specialist sub-contract work for main contractors

### Artizanni Interiors
Interior design, fit-out, joinery and furnishing in Abuja, Lagos and Port Harcourt. Artizanni Interiors carries our finishing work: homes, offices, retail and hospitality spaces. Tolerances are visible here, so we plan fit-outs around drying times, delivery dates and the day you need to open.
- Interior design concepts, mood boards and space planning
- Materials, finishes and FF&E schedules (local and imported)
- Ceilings, partitions, tiling, stone and decoration
- Kitchens, wardrobes, counters and bespoke joinery
- Lighting schemes and electrical fit-out
- Retail fit-out: shelving, gondolas and display systems

### Real Estate & Land
Land sourcing, title verification, acquisition and development. Most property losses in Nigeria start before anything is built: the wrong title, the wrong seller or the wrong plot. We help you find, verify and secure land or property, then develop it.
- Land and property sourcing against your brief, with comparable-price analysis and negotiation support
- Title due diligence with a lawyer and surveyor (C of O, Governor's consent, survey charting, excision)
- Acquisition, documentation and perfection of title
- Feasibility studies and development appraisals
- Estate planning, design and delivery
- Technical due diligence before purchase: site, soil, drainage, access and structural condition
- Sales advisory for owners disposing of property
- Customer due diligence (KYC/AML) as required for real-estate transactions

### Project & Property Management
Cost, programme and quality control for your project, then care of the asset. If you already have a designer or a contractor, we can stand on your side of the table: plan the work, check the quantities, certify valuations and report progress, then manage the property after handover.
- Project planning, programmes and procurement plans
- Bills of quantities, cost plans and valuation checks
- Site supervision, quality inspections and progress reports with photos
- Contract administration, variations and payment certificates
- Property and facility management: tenant sourcing and screening, lease administration, rent collection
- Planned and reactive maintenance with documented work orders and service-charge reporting
- Long-term estate management strategy

### Built-Environment Personnel
Engineers, supervisors and skilled artisans supplied and managed for your project. Projects stall when the right people are not on site. We supply and manage qualified engineers, site supervisors, foremen and artisans for clients' projects, on short or long engagements.
- Site engineers and supervisors
- Foremen and trade gangs: masons, steel fixers, carpenters, tilers, plumbers, electricians
- Quantity surveying and planning support
- HSE officers and storekeepers
- Vetting, onboarding and site induction
- Supervision and replacement cover

### Secure Spaces
Discreet design and construction of safe rooms for homes and offices. We design and build protected rooms within new and existing buildings. This work is handled on a strict need-to-know basis: we do not publish projects, photographs, clients or specifications.
- Confidential consultation at a place of your choosing
- Protection level agreed with you before design
- Integration with the building's structure, services and escape routes
- Small, vetted delivery team
- Confidential documentation and handover

## Build from abroad (escrow)
For Nigerians abroad: your money is held in escrow by First Trustees and released only against verified milestones.

- M0: Title verified and permit obtained (evidence: Lawyer's title report; permit copy)
- M1: Site cleared, set out, foundation complete (evidence: Geotagged photos and video; foundation inspection record)
- M2: Ground-floor slab / DPC (evidence: 7-day concrete cube results; photos; QS valuation)
- M3: Frame to roof level (each floor a sub-milestone) (evidence: 28-day cube results; reinforcement inspection sign-offs)
- M4: Roof covered (evidence: Photos and valuation)
- M5: Services first fix, windows, plaster (evidence: Inspection records)
- M6: Finishes, services second fix, external works (evidence: Draft snag list)
- M7: Practical completion and handover (evidence: Handover certificate, as-built drawings, keys)
- M8: End of defects liability period (evidence: Defects closed; retention released)

## FAQ

Q: Do I pay anything up front?
A: No. There are no upfront payments. Once scope and price are agreed, construction funds go into escrow with First Trustees, and every payment after that is pro rata against certified progress.

Q: Who holds my money?
A: Your construction funds are paid into an escrow arrangement with First Trustees, an independent trustee company, not into Artizanni's account. Funds are released to us in stages, only when the milestone agreed in your contract has been completed and evidenced.

Q: How do I know a milestone has really been reached?
A: For every release we prepare a Milestone Verification Pack: dated, geotagged photographs, a video walk-through, inspection and test records (for example concrete cube results) and a quantity surveyor's valuation. It is countersigned by our Managing Director and, where your escrow deed requires it, by an independent verifier.

Q: Do I need to buy the land first?
A: No. We can source land against your brief. Before any money moves for land, a lawyer and surveyor carry out title due diligence (C of O, Governor's consent, survey charting, excision and family-land checks) and you receive a go / no-go report.

Q: Will I get regular updates?
A: Yes: a weekly written report with photos and video, scheduled calls in your time zone, and the verification pack at every milestone.

Q: What do you need from me to start?
A: A short discovery call, then identity and source-of-funds checks. As a SCUML-registered business we must complete customer due diligence before any real-estate transaction. Your details are kept confidential.

Q: Should I give someone power of attorney?
A: Only after legal advice, and never as a substitute for escrow. A power of attorney can be misused; the escrow and milestone structure is designed so you do not have to rely on any one person's honesty.

Q: Can you manage the property after it is built?
A: Yes. We offer property and facility management after handover: tenancy support, maintenance and periodic inspection reports.

Q: Which locations do you work in?
A: We are based in Utako, Abuja. Our recorded work spans Lagos, Ogun, Osun, Nasarawa, Benue and Cross River States and transmission sites in the South-West and North-Central. Interiors are offered in Abuja, Lagos and Port Harcourt. Tell us where your project is and we will confirm.

Q: Do you only take design-and-build contracts?
A: No. You can appoint us for design only, engineering only, construction to someone else's design, project management, or interiors.

Q: How do you price a project?
A: After the brief and a site visit we prepare an estimate that states its basis, date and accuracy. A firm price follows design and a bill of quantities. Prices show VAT separately.

Q: Are your designs approved and sealed?
A: Engineering drawings are sealed by a COREN-registered engineer; architectural drawings for permits are sealed by an ARCON-registered architect.
